sources.title: IKDiffuser: A Generative Inverse Kinematics Solver for Multi-arm Robots ...
sources.snippet: We propose IKDiffuser, a diffusion-based generative model for solving inverse kinematics in multi-arm robotic systems. IKDiffuser frames the inverse kinematics problem as the aforementioned op-timization with the idea of analysis by synthesis, where the optimization is achieved by sampling from the latent distribution of a generative model.
